fee_notes: Royalty tiered: 5% if territory density ≥$0.04/person, 6% if <$0.04/person. Minimum weekly: Y1 $150, Y2 $350, Y3 $700, Y4+ $800. Advertising 2% gross sales, minimum weekly: Y1 $75, Y2 $175, Y3 $350, Y4+ $400. Managed Services fee variable; Technology fee tiered by roles, reviewed up to 2x/year. All payments due Thursday of 8th week after contract signature.
